scope.age_claim: provisional ages-3-to-5 developmental calibration; never infant calibration

primary_engine.name: TDW
primary_engine.attempt_policy: one isolated install-launch-render attempt plus at most one compatibility repair

fallback_engine.name: BlenderProc/Blender
fallback_engine.selection_rule: use immediately and exclusively if the frozen TDW compatibility gate fails

canonical_media.clock: integer ticks at 24000 Hz with frame timestamps derived exactly from tick/fps

splits.train: disjoint object instances, scene, texture, voice-condition keys
splits.validation: disjoint object instances, scene, texture, voice-condition keys
splits.test: disjoint object instances, scene, texture, voice-condition keys

estimators.participant_inference: participant-clustered intervals from 18 development participants; never treat windows as independent participants
estimators.synthetic_scoring: decode emitted MP4/WAV and side-stream files only; generator targets and declared feature metadata are forbidden inputs
estimators.v5_pixel_motion: mean over adjacent decoded 1-fps RGB frames of mean absolute uint8 channel difference divided by 255
estimators.v5_adjacent_frame_persistence: mean adjacent-frame cosine similarity of the exact frozen local DINOv2 embeddings used by ChildLens V5; unavailable unless the hash-bound V5 processor/model are present
estimators.v5_scene_change_rate: fraction of adjacent decoded 1-fps pairs whose v5_pixel_motion exceeds 0.20
estimators.audio_log_rms: natural logarithm of decoded mono float waveform RMS with floor 1e-12
estimators.audio_non_silent_fraction: fraction of 20-ms decoded waveform windows above frozen RMS threshold 0.001
estimators.audio_clipped_fraction: fraction of decoded waveform samples with absolute amplitude at least 0.999

gates.engine: short deterministic egocentric manipulation emits usable RGB, instance visibility/segmentation, depth when supported, collision/contact, pose/joint state, and timestamps
gates.output_distribution: for every comparable ChildLens observable, bounded-pilot synthetic mean lies in participant-clustered 90% interval, all values remain in support, and synthetic q10/q50/q90 each lies within the empirical participant q10-to-q90 envelope where published
gates.causal_integrity: all modalities share one event graph, physical state, and clock; contact is collision-derived
gates.language_integrity: script/timestamps exact; decoded WAV nonempty/unclipped; fixed Anna de_DE synthesis succeeds; transcript-to-script token equality
gates.anti_leakage: no labels in side streams, paths, IDs, manifests, render tokens, transcripts outside the training text field, or across splits
gates.learner: official pinned preprocessing and CLIP+ interfaces run locally on MPS/CPU
gates.controls: held-out instance/scene/voice oracle exceeds 0.80 accuracy and destroyed mapping is within exact binomial 95% chance interval
gates.failure_policy: any required gate failure terminates NO_GO_MEDIA_GROUNDING_ENV; do not alter a frozen estimator, backend, TTS, learner, threshold, or split after scoring

fallback_policy.tdw_failure: use the pinned BlenderProc/Blender fallback immediately
fallback_policy.tts_failure: terminate and report bounded options; no model cycling
fallback_policy.learner_failure: terminate and report bounded options; no substitute learner
fallback_policy.calibration_failure: terminate NO_GO; no tuning after bounded pilot score
fallback_policy.diffusion: deferred appearance-only robustness arm; forbidden in readiness work
